links.outcome: Model performance on internal versus external multi-site test datasets for ocular sign detection
links.effect: Internal AUCs of 71.09%, 80.81%, 90.07%, and 82.86%; external AUCs ranged 55.58%-84.29% across two test datasets, showing variation across sites.
links.quote: SegmenView achieved internal Area Under the Curve (AUCs) of 71.09%, 80.81%, 90.07%, and 82.86%; external AUCs ranging 55.58%-84.29% across two test datasets, outperforming half-face and periocular models.

unlisted_practices: Segmenting only essential ocular regions from facial images to minimize non-essential information and protect patient privacy
Comparing segmentation-based privacy preservation against other privacy-preserving image methods

screen.reason: Evaluates a strategic anatomical segmentation approach compared to standard half-face images and other de-identification/privacy-preserving methods to safeguard patient privacy while maintaining diagnostic performance across external datasets.
